text: Parses X12-820 (005010X218) transactions Medicaid/Medicare capitation premium payments. Designed California DHCS PACE capitation remittances handles general 820 format used state Medicaid agencies.

X12-820 (X306/X218) Payment Order/Remittance Advice Parser — parse_820
text: Key segments parsed: ISA/GS: Interchange group headers (source ID, report date) BPR: Payment amount effective date TRN: EFT/check trace number N1/N3/N4: Payer payee name address ENT: Per-member entity loop start NM1: Member name ID RMR: Remittance line item (reference number, payment amount) REF*18: Rate code (e.g., 957 = PACE rate) REF*ZZ: Aid code/plan type composite description DTM*582: Coverage period date range ADX: Adjustment amount reason code Typical loop structure within 820-X218: Header: ISA > GS > ST > BPR > TRN > N1*PE > N1*PR Per-member: ENT > NM1 > (RMR > REF*18 > REF*ZZ > REF*ZZ > DTM*582 > ADX) Trailer: SE > GE > IEA

title: X12-834 (X220A1) Benefit Enrollment Parser — parse_834
text: transports member demographics, dependents, chosen plan, effective end dates, premium amounts, occasionally tax elements primary care provider. system record membership payer side. 834 heavily used BPaaS (Benefits Administration Service): Workday Benefits ADP TotalSource bswift BenefitFocus Empyrean also official pipe ACA state exchanges / marketplaces payers. Open Enrollment window (November – December) produces volume spikes stress overnight batch jobs. Extracts enrollment demographic data 834 transactions focus : Risk adjustment fields (dual eligibility, OREC/CREC, SNP, LTI) CA DHCS FAME-specific fields HCP (Health Care Plan) coverage history

text: 837 describes care event: (rendering provider, supervising physician, referring), (subscriber, patient), (ICD-10 diagnosis, CPT/HCPCS procedure), (service date, units), (place service), much (charged amount, contractual reference). Three TR3s segment audience: 005010X222A1: 837P Professional (Physicians, Ambulatory, Telemedicine) 005010X223A2: 837I Institutional (Hospitals, ED, Hospice) 005010X224A2: 837D Dental

X12-837I (X223A3) & X12-837P (X222A2) Health Care Claim Parser — parse_837
text: 837 highest-volume transaction US healthcare EDI. Every commercial public payer (Medicare, Medicaid, Tricare) consumes hundreds millions per month. entire provider-side billing revolves around generation: EHR (Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, NextGen) PMS (Kareo, AdvancedMD, eClinicalWorks), clearinghouse (Availity, Change Healthcare, Waystar, Trizetto), 277CA, 999, ultimately 835 returns.

title: X12-837I (X223A3) & X12-837P (X222A2) Health Care Claim Parser — parse_837
text: 2000A Billing Provider (Practice Facility, NPI, Taxonomy, TIN) 2000B Subscriber Loop (Contract Holder) SBR: Subscriber Information relationship code Claim filing indicator (CI Commercial Insurance, MB Medicare Part B, MC Medicaid, etc.) 2000C Patient Loop (Patient different Subscriber). claim level, CLM Claim Information carries patient account, total charge, facility code, claim frequency. HI Health Care Information Codes carries ICD-10 diagnoses (qualifier ABK Principal Diagnosis, ABF Diagnosis). service section groups LX + SV1 (Professional) / SV2 (Institutional) / SV3 (Dental) detailing procedure CPT / HCPCS / CDT code, modifiers, units, charge, service date via DTP.
